feeds.title: Politics North Carolina
feeds.description: PoliticsNC is a blog and news site developed by political consultant Thomas Mills with the creative and technical support of Amanda Underwood. The goal is to provide at least one blog per day and a reasoned voice in the political debate at a time when throwing rocks and calling names is far more popular.

feeds.title: NC Newsline
feeds.description: NC Policy Watch, a project of the North Carolina Justice Center, is a news and commentary outlet dedicated to informing the public including elected officials as they debate important issues and ultimately to improving the quality of life for all North Carolinians.

feeds.title: The Progressive Pulse
feeds.description: Stories and voices that matter. The Progressive Pulse is a nonpartisan blog about the issues, debates, and people that affect North Carolina public policy.

feeds.title: John Locke Foundation
feeds.description: The John Locke Foundation envisions a strong North Carolina commitment to individual freedom, personal responsibility, and limited, constitutional government, both now and for future generations.

feeds.title: Libertarian Party of North Carolina
feeds.description: In the Business of Advancing Liberty and Shrinking Big Government Bureaucracy. Their mission leverages their political influence at the state and local levels to promote candidates and policies consistent with their platform.

feeds.title: WAVY TV 10 North Carolina Politics
feeds.description: The Latest News and Updates in North Carolina Politics are brought to you by the team at WAVY-TV 10.

feeds.title: NC Politics Politics
feeds.description: Get the latest news for the Charlotte region and beyond. Covers articles on political updates and news.

feeds.title: FOX 46 Charlotte Politics
feeds.description: FOX 46 Charlotte provides you the latest breaking news, local news, weather, sports and traffic in North Carolina and South Carolina communities. Covers articles on political updates and news.

feeds.title: WUNC Politics
feeds.description: WUNC provides high-quality news, cultural, and entertainment content to create a more informed and engaged community. It Covers Political news from around NC and beyond.

feeds.title: The Rant Politics
feeds.description: The Rant is a news site based in Sanford, North Carolina, covering news and features in the region. Covers articles on political updates and news.

feeds.title: Old North State Politics
feeds.description: A public scholarship blog that focuses on North Carolina politics and other random political ramblings regarding the politics of the U.S. South and and the United States.

feeds.title: Progress NC Action Blog
feeds.description: We are a team of communications and digital experts building a dialogue between North Carolinians, elected officials and progressive organizations throughout North Carolina. Cutting Through The Noise Delivering commentary backed up by fact-based information surrounding NC politics and how these issues can impact our everyday lives.

feeds.title: Spectrum News 1 » Politics
feeds.description: Get your North Carolina political news from Spectrum News. Spectrum News 1 is dedicated to providing compelling, accurate and balanced local news and information that's important to you in Charlotte, Triad, Triangle and coastal areas of the state. We aim to promote quality conversation surrounding the biggest issues facing North Carolinians.

feeds.title: Talking About Politics
feeds.description: Carter Wrenn and Gary Pearce don't see eye-to-eye on many issues. But they both love North Carolina and know its politics inside and out. Carter is a Republican. Gary is a Democrat. They enjoy talking about politics. So they started this blog in 2005 about local, North Carolina, US or International Politics.

feeds.title: Carolina Demography Blog
feeds.description: Carolina Demography is made up of demographic researchers, evaluators, spatial analysts, coders, designers, and storytellers. We specialize in population estimates, forecasts, trend analysis, and communicating our findings in a way that's easy to understand and act upon. Keep up with our latest demographic insights.

feeds.title: New South Politics » North Carolina
feeds.description: New South Politics provides political news analysis and commentary from Matt O'Hern, who has worked with political campaigns in the southeast, including Alabama, since 2002. O'Hern created New South Politics to cover remarkable trends in political news impacting southern states.

feeds.title: Just Vote No Blog
feeds.description: This is a personal website - expressing random opinions stumbled upon or discussed with politically-inclined friends. Our friends happen to be Berniecrats; Kennedy Democrats; Libertarians; Goldwater, Reagan, and Ron Paul Republicans; and assorted small-government advocates. The thoughts expressed here mainly concern political actions by legislators as well as voters that contribute to the advance of soft despotism.

feeds.title: Carolina Journal
feeds.description: Carolina Journal is a pioneer in nonprofit journalism, publishing thousands of articles on politics, education, health care, regulations, taxes, and other issues since its founding in 1991. In addition to news, CJ offers readers in-depth investigative stories, polling, cartoons, commentary, video interviews, and analysis. Check out the latest news from the political circle, press, election news and more!

feeds.title: Charlotte Stories » Politics
feeds.description: Charlotte Stories is a community page about news, events, and local businesses around Charlotte. Stay up to date with the latest political happenings in Charlotte and around North Carolina, speeches, announcements from political parties and more!

feeds.title: Charlotte Citizen Blog
feeds.description: I'm a Charlotte citizen. I'm also a husband to Alex, a dog dad to Davey, a book worm, and a lawyer. We need to tell the truth about those in power. Doing so, without fear or favor and in a spirit of perpetual rebellion, is a citizen's work. I hope to do some of that work here, and I hope you'll help me. Check out my articles on political news and updates around Charlotte and the NC.

feeds.title: Now Or Never North Carolina Blog
feeds.description: Now or Never NC backs top challengers who strongly support public education, redistricting reform, voter access, women's reproductive rights, and who have an appreciation for local governance. Know more about the political parties' stands, speeches, announcements and more!

feeds.title: CaryCitizen » Government
feeds.description: Established in 2009, CaryCitizen is the online news source covering Cary, North Carolina. With 1.5 million annual page views specifically in the Cary area, we remain the best choice for all the news and information on Cary. The government section is dedicated to all the news and updates on government policies, initiatives, news and more in the area.
